pass_fail_thresholds.geometry: no degenerate margins; Hamming/embedding relation no worse than synthetic proxy baseline without explanation

required_corpus.answer_structure: question/answer segments with loss_mask answer-active spans preserved
required_corpus.format: Phase 1 PQA1 files with tokenizer hashes matching Gemma4 manifest
required_corpus.identity: source manifest, license/corpus provenance, vocab hash, merges hash, PQA1 source SHA-256 stream
required_corpus.labels_or_objectives: real task labels or training objective metadata for information-bottleneck k decisions; proxy cosine is insufficient
required_corpus.token_diversity: must include measured unique-token count, target >=50000 distinct token IDs for production floor gate

why_required: Synthetic/proxy gates cannot prove production token distribution, answer-span repetition, real-label information retention, or final k/projection promotion.
